news.title: Telugu version of Nivin Pauly and Soori's film delayed
news.summary: The Telugu dubbed version of the Tamil film Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai, titled Sanchari, has been pushed past its planned October 1 release date. Directed by Ram and starring Nivin Pauly and Soori, the release was put on hold due to a title dispute. Producers will announce a fresh arrival date soon.

news.title: Mahesh Babu praises Fahadh Faasil's upcoming Telugu movie
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu watched a special screening of Fahadh Faasil's debut Telugu feature Don't Trouble The Trouble and lauded its heartwarming and entertaining narrative on social media. Directed by Shashank Yeleti and presented by S.S. Rajamouli, the film is scheduled to open in theaters on October 2.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika share new details about Ranabaali
news.summary: In the second episode of their promotional documentary series, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika discussed how British colonial rule utilized the railway network to drain Indian resources. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the period drama Ranabaali is slated to hit the big screen on October 16.

news.title: Ravi Teja's nephew's debut movie Maremma sets dual OTT premiere
news.summary: Maremma, the rural drama marking the acting debut of Maadhav Bhupathiraju, is heading to digital streaming platforms following its theatrical run last month. The movie has locked in a simultaneous release on Aha and Amazon Prime Video scheduled for October 9, 2026.

news.title: Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's Fauji Postpones Release Date
news.summary: The theatrical release of the Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi project Fauji has been delayed indefinitely. Production remains incomplete, and lead actor Prabhas still has significant working days left to shoot for the movie alongside his other commitments.

news.title: Salman Khan and Vamshi Paidipally's Action Film Enlists Star-Studded Ensemble
news.summary: Director Vamshi Paidipally's high-budget action movie starring Salman Khan has assembled a major supporting cast featuring Nayanthara, Arvind Swamy, Anil Kapoor, and Jackie Shroff. Bankrolled by Dil Raju, the project is halfway through production and aiming for an Eid 2027 release.

news.title: Nani Hits Andhra to Lift The Paradise Box Office
news.summary: Actor Nani has traveled to Gannavaram and planned visits to Vijayawada, Guntur, and Ongole to boost momentum for The Paradise. The makers initiated the tour following a slowdown in theater occupancy across Andhra Pradesh. The core team hopes that direct fan interactions during the extended holiday period will spark renewed interest.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti Lines Up Bollywood Entry With Sanjay Leela Bhansali
news.summary: Director Chandoo Mondeti is heading to Bollywood for an upcoming project starring Akshay Kumar and Rana Daggubati. Sanjay Leela Bhansali is on board to produce the untitled film under Bhansali Productions. Reports also indicate that Bhansali provided the storyline for the feature, which is set to begin production soon.

news.title: Ravi Teja Starrer Irumudi Claims Global Netflix Crown
news.summary: Ravi Teja's Irumudi has secured the top spot on Netflix's Global Top 10 list for non-English films for the week of September 21 to 27. The Telugu movie gathered 3.4 million views during its first full week on the platform. Directed by Shiva Nirvana, the family drama features supporting performances by Sai Kumar and Priya Bhavani Shankar.

news.title: Sardar 2 and Romanchakam Head Up Regional OTT Premieres
news.summary: Several multi-language films and series are scheduled for digital streaming over the weekend. Karthi's Sardar 2 and the Telugu feature Romanchakam are among the notable titles arriving on OTT platforms. Viewers can also catch releases like the Malayalam film Bethlehem Kudumba Unit across various services.

news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's Raaka to arrive in two parts
news.summary: Industry buzz suggests that Allu Arjun and Atlee's highly anticipated project Raaka will be split into two installments due to its massive scale. The first chapter is reportedly slated for a December 2027 release, with the sequel following in 2028. Backed by Sun Pictures, the high-budget venture features an ensemble cast including Deepika Padukone, Mrunal Thakur, Rashmika Mandanna, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lakshmi, with music by Sai Abhyannkar.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela's The Paradise Hits Nizam Breakeven in Six Days
news.summary: Despite mixed initial reactions, Nani's latest movie The Paradise has successfully recovered its investments in the Nizam territory within its first six days. The action drama, featuring music by Anirudh Ravichander and a strong supporting cast, continues its box office journey as the lead actor actively promotes the project across Andhra Pradesh.

news.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Gears Up for Fourth Single Featuring Nora Fatehi
news.summary: The makers of the Rajinikanth starrer Jailer 2 are releasing the film's fourth single today, which features a special dance appearance by Bollywood actress Nora Fatehi. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and backed by Sun Pictures with music by Anirudh Ravichander, the movie is slated to hit the big screens on October 15, 2026. Following the success of previous tracks, this upcoming upbeat number aims to further amp up promotions ahead of the theatrical debut.

news.title: Jr NTR Announces Complete Recovery from Shoulder Surgery and Prepares for Dragon Filming
news.summary: During a recent promotional event, actor Jr NTR shared that he has completely healed from his shoulder injury and subsequent surgery. He is now set to resume shooting for Prashanth Neel's upcoming directorial venture, Dragon, which aims for a June 2027 release. Following this project, the star is slated to collaborate with director Trivikram on a mythological film.

news.title: Jr NTR gives massive promotional boost to Fahadh Faasil's upcoming release
news.summary: Jr NTR stepped in to support the promotional campaign for Don't Trouble The Trouble, starring Fahadh Faasil and produced by SS Karthikeya. His attendance instantly drew widespread social media attention and spiked curiosity ahead of the October 2 premiere. Even with the sudden surge in online traction, industry insiders note that organic word-of-mouth will ultimately dictate its theatrical success.

news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's big-budget action spectacle eyes a multi-part release
news.summary: Icon Star Allu Arjun is currently immersed in filming Raaka, an ambitious international-standard project directed by Atlee and backed by Sun Pictures. Given the massive financial scale and production requirements, the makers are actively planning to roll out the narrative in two parts, with the first installment slated for December 2027 and the follow-up in 2028. The star-studded cast features Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, Mrunal Thakur, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lekshmi in prominent roles.

news.title: Ravi Teja's action drama claims the top spot on global streaming charts
news.summary: Ravi Teja's hit film Irumudi has surged to the number one position globally on Netflix's Non-English Movies category for the week of September 21-27, 2026. The movie pulled in 3.4 lakh views during the tracking week, successfully climbing past Surya's Vishwanath & Sons. Directed by Shiva Nirvana and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the project is enjoying a powerful second wave on digital platforms following its theatrical run.

news.title: Sreeleela joins the cast of Rajinikanth's upcoming starrer Dharman
news.summary: Actress Sreeleela has officially begun shooting for her role in Rajinikanth's upcoming film Dharman, getting spotted by fans on location in Mysuru. Helmed by director Ashwath Marimuthu and produced by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, the movie also stars Ram Pothineni and Raashi Khanna. Sreeleela plays an important part in the project, which features music composed by Anirudh Ravichander.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Gears Up for His Silver Jubilee Project
news.summary: Actor Naga Chaitanya is getting ready to launch his milestone 25th film, directed by Clax. The project will be produced by Bunny Vas and presented by Allu Aravind, with an official launch scheduled for October. Meanwhile, the actor is preparing for the December release of his high-budget mystical thriller Vrushakarma.

news.title: Rumors Surface Regarding Allu Arjun's Character in Lokesh Kanagaraj Project
news.summary: Speculation is growing around the highly anticipated pan-Indian collaboration between Allu Arjun and director Lokesh Kanagaraj, commonly referred to as AA23. Reports suggest the star actor might take on multiple avatars, including a serious police officer role. However, the filmmakers have not yet provided official confirmation regarding these character details.

news.title: Anand Deverakonda's Recent Starrer Eyes Digital Premiere
news.summary: Epic - First Semester, which starred Anand Deverakonda and Vaishnavi Chaitanya, is reportedly heading towards its digital debut. Although official confirmation remains pending, the film is expected to land on an OTT platform on October 9, 2026. The upcoming release may offer the movie a second chance to engage audiences after falling short of expectations in theaters.

news.title: Box Office Analysis Highlights a Quiet Month for Tollywood
news.summary: September 2026 proved to be a mostly subdued period for the Telugu film industry, with Nani's The Paradise emerging as the month's top grosser despite facing mixed reviews and negative campaigns. Most other new theatrical releases struggled to make a significant commercial impact during this timeframe.

news.title: Why These Two Big-Budget Ventures Are Giving Headaches to Mythri Movie Makers
news.summary: Prominent Tollywood banner Mythri Movie Makers is currently facing intense financial and scheduling pressure regarding two major films in their lineup. The Prabhas-starrer periodic drama Fauzi, directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, has exceeded its initial budget and missed its anticipated December release window. Meanwhile, the Prashanth Neel-directed Dragon featuring NTR has also been delayed due to the lead actor's injury, leaving the studio with heavy financial stakes riding on both projects.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj Teams Up With Upendra and Prabhu Deva for a Netflix Movie
news.summary: Director Karthik Subbaraj has shared exciting updates about his upcoming direct-to-OTT project for Netflix during promotional events for his film Dorothy. The new venture brings together a notable cast featuring Upendra, Prabhu Deva, and Atharva in significant roles. Inspired by a novel centered on Puliyattam, the film has already quietly completed a portion of its shooting schedule.

news.title: Yash Starrer Toxic Skips October OTT Release Plans
news.summary: The digital premiere of the Geetu Mohandas directorial Toxic has hit another roadblock after failing to secure a spot in ZEE5's October streaming lineup. Following an underwhelming theatrical run after its August release, fans who missed the movie in theaters must endure a longer wait for its digital debut. The big-budget action drama stars Yash, Kiara Advani, Nayanthara, and others, with the makers yet to declare a fresh streaming date.
